title: A localized polynomial ideal relation is witnessed over a finite coefficient stage
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring, $R_0\subseteq R$ a finite type integer subring [def-weil-pbc-finite-type-algebra], $n\geq 0$, $p_1,\ldots,p_m,a\in R_0[x_1,\ldots,x_n]$ [def-weil-pbc-mv-polynomial-ring], and $Q\subset R[x]$ a prime ideal. Write $L=R[x]_Q$ [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime] and let bars denote coefficientwise images followed by localization. If $x\in L$ satisfies $\bar a x\in(\bar p_1,\ldots,\bar p_m)$, then there exist a finite type integer subring $B$ with $R_0\subseteq B\subseteq R$, a ring homomorphism $\phi:B[x]_{Q_B}\to L$ with $Q_B=Q\cap B[x]$, and $y\in B[x]_{Q_B}$ such that $\phi$ agrees with coefficient inclusion and localization on every polynomial, $\phi(y)=x$, and $a_B y\in(p_{1,B},\ldots,p_{m,B})$. The subscripts denote the coefficientwise images in the stage localization. The list can be empty. Ideals generated by lists are the prefix ideals appearing in [def-weil-pbc-regular-sequence].

source.place: Proof, filtered-colimit paragraphs and displayed identification of all prefix quotients; the finite-support localization argument is expanded here.

proof.text: Represent x as z/d using IsLocalization.exists_mk'_eq. Ideal.map_ofList identifies the localized ideal with the localization of the polynomial ideal. IsLocalization.mk'_mem_map_algebraMap_iff yields t outside Q with t*a*z in the polynomial ideal. Ideal.mem_span_range_iff_exists_fun expresses it as a finite sum indexed by the positions in ps.

Take the finite union of the coefficient sets of z, d, t and all polynomial multipliers. Put A=Algebra.adjoin R0 of this set and B=A.toSubring. A contains R0, is finite type over R0 by Subalgebra.fg_def and fg_iff_finiteType, and is finite type over the integers by Algebra.FiniteType.trans. MvPolynomial.mem_range_map_iff_coeffs_subset lifts every selected polynomial to B.

Both lifted denominators d_B and t_B avoid the contracted prime by definition of Ideal.comap. Define phi by IsLocalization.map for the polynomial inclusion. IsLocalization.map_eq proves its compatibility with every polynomial and map_mk' proves that the fraction y=z_B/d_B maps to x.

MvPolynomial.map_injective for the subtype inclusion transfers the finite sum equality into B[x]. It shows t_B*a_B*z_B is in the stage polynomial ideal. IsLocalization.mk'_mem_map_algebraMap_iff, using t_B, proves a_B*y is in the localized ideal. Ideal.map_ofList gives precisely the required list of generators. The empty list has an empty sum, and zero variables cause no change to the argument.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_finiteType_subring_local_ideal_relation
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] (R₀ : Subring R)
    (hR₀ : Algebra.FiniteType ℤ R₀) {n : ℕ}
    (ps : List (MvPolynomial (Fin n) R₀)) (a : MvPolynomial (Fin n) R₀)
    (Q : Ideal (MvPolynomial (Fin n) R)) [Q.IsPrime]
    (x : Localization.AtPrime Q)
    (hx : algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin n) R) (Localization.AtPrime Q)
        (MvPolynomial.map R₀.subtype a) * x ∈
      Ideal.ofList (ps.map (fun p ↦
        algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin n) R) (Localization.AtPrime Q)
          (MvPolynomial.map R₀.subtype p)))) :
    ∃ (B : Subring R) (hB : R₀ ≤ B), Algebra.FiniteType ℤ B ∧
      ∃ (φ : Localization.AtPrime (Q.comap (MvPolynomial.map B.subtype)) →+*
          Localization.AtPrime Q),
        (∀ p : MvPolynomial (Fin n) B,
          φ (algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin n) B)
              (Localization.AtPrime (Q.comap (MvPolynomial.map B.subtype))) p) =
            algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin n) R) (Localization.AtPrime Q)
              (MvPolynomial.map B.subtype p)) ∧
        ∃ y : Localization.AtPrime (Q.comap (MvPolynomial.map B.subtype)),
          φ y = x ∧
          algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin n) B)
              (Localization.AtPrime (Q.comap (MvPolynomial.map B.subtype)))
              (MvPolynomial.map (Subring.inclusion hB) a) * y ∈
            Ideal.ofList (ps.map (fun p ↦
              algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin n) B)
                (Localization.AtPrime (Q.comap (MvPolynomial.map B.subtype)))
                (MvPolynomial.map (Subring.inclusion hB) p)))
